name: Shrimp Chow Fun
assumptions: Recipe scaled for 2-4 people based on 227g prawns and 250g dry noodles; conservatively estimated at 3 servings as typical for stir-fry noodle dish with these quantities.
Total active and passive time (soak overnight excluded per standard recipe timing conventions; boil 15 min + marinade 5 min + stir-fry 15-20 min) rounded to 45 minutes.
Oyster sauce classified as containing potential fish/seafood extract (ambiguous without brand spec).
Soy sauce and oyster sauce assumed to contain wheat unless certified gluten-free (ambiguous).
Sesame oil present; no tree nuts or peanuts listed.
instructions:
STEP 1 - SOAK THE RICE NOODLES
Soak the rice noodles overnight untill they are soft
STEP 2 - BOIL THE RICE NOODLES
Boil the noodles for 10-15 minutes and then rinse with cold water to stop the cooking process of the noodles.
STEP 3 -MARINATING THE SHRIMP
In a bowl add the shrimp, egg, 1 pinch of white pepper, 1 Teaspoon of sesame seed oil, 1 Tablespoon corn starch and 1 tablespoon of oil
Mix together well
STEP 4 - STIR FRY
In a wok add 2 Tablespoons of oil, shrimp and stir fry them until it is golden brown
Set the shrimp aside
Add 1 Tablespoon of oil to the work and then add minced garlic, ginger and all of the vegetables.
Add the noodles to the wok
Next add sherry cooking wine, oyster sauce, sugar, vinegar, sesame seed oil, 1 pinch white pepper, and soy sauce
Add back in the shrimp
To thicken the sauce, whisk together 1 Tablespoon of corn starch and 2 Tablespoon of water in a bowl and slowly add to your stir-fry until it's the right thickness.

ingredients.name: Rice Stick Noodles
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 bag of rice stick noodles assumed as 250g dry weight (typical 500g bag); dry rice noodles used as base before soaking/boiling per instructions.

ingredients.name: Prawns
ingredients.assumptions: 8 oz prawns (shrimp) as raw peeled weight; typical for stir-fry recipes, using peeled prawn nutrition.

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 egg estimated at 25g edible portion (half of a large ~50g egg without shell).

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of pepper (white pepper) estimated at 1g; negligible nutrition but included as required.

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Total 2 tsp sesame seed oil across recipe (1 tsp in marinade + 1 tsp in sauce); 9g total edible oil weight.

ingredients.name: Cornstarch
ingredients.assumptions: Total 2 tbs cornstarch (1 tbs in marinade + 1 tbs for thickening slurry); 16g total dry weight.

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Total 4 tbs neutral oil for stir-frying and marinade (2 tbs stir-fry shrimp + 1 tbs vegetables + 1 tbs marinade); assumed vegetable oil, 14g per tbs.

ingredients.name: Minced Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp minced garlic estimated at 5g fresh weight.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp minced ginger estimated at 2g fresh weight.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 cup sliced onion estimated at 80g raw edible weight.

ingredients.name: Bean Sprouts
ingredients.assumptions: 1 cup fresh bean sprouts estimated at 105g raw edible weight.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 cup chopped spring onions (scallions) estimated at 50g raw edible weight.

ingredients.name: Cooking wine
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbs Chinese cooking wine (sherry) estimated at 15g.

ingredients.name: Oyster Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbs oyster sauce estimated at 15g typical bottled weight.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbs soy sauce estimated at 15g typical bottled weight.
